raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Left-boundary support node set",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The prose does not specify the restrained nodes, and no support extent is readable in the supplied schematic.",
      "readings": [
        "Fix both displacement components at every node on the left edge.",
        "Fix both displacement components only at the upper-left and lower-left corner nodes."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4 opening paragraph refers support placement to Fig. 9; Sec. 4.2 and the attached cantilever schematic provide no readable support node set."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Vertical center of the right-edge load line",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The load is depicted near mid-height, but its center has no stated coordinate or symmetry condition. Let H denote the rectangle height.",
      "readings": [
        "Center the loaded line exactly at y=H/2.",
        "Center it at approximately y=0.47H, following the apparent arrow attachment in the supplied image."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4 opening paragraph and Fig. 9(a), supplied cantilever schematic."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Reference length L defining the loaded-line length",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The line length is specified as L/10, but the supplied text does not define L and no dimension labels are readable in the attachment.",
      "readings": [
        "L is the rectangle height H, giving a loaded length of 0.1H.",
        "L is the rectangle span 2H, giving a loaded length of 0.2H."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4 opening paragraph specifies a line of L/10; Fig. 9(a) is cited for domain dimensions."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Force distribution along the loaded line",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Application along a line is specified without a traction profile or nodal weighting rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply constant line traction using consistent nodal forces, with half weights at the segment endpoints.",
        "Split the total force equally among all nodes on the segment, including its endpoints."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4 opening paragraph describes line loading but gives no distribution formula."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Downward load normalization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither the total resultant nor the line-force intensity is specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Use unit total resultant F=1 distributed over the line.",
        "Use unit line-force intensity q=1, giving total resultant F=L/10."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4 opening paragraph, Sec. 4.2, and Fig. 9(a) provide no numerical force magnitude."
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Radius of the solidified neighborhood around the load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The load neighborhood is described only as having a small radius; its size is not given.",
      "readings": [
        "Use radius r=h_c around the loaded line.",
        "Use radius r=2h_c around the loaded line."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4 opening paragraph states that elements with density greater than 0.99 and in a small radius around the load are set to solid."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid-material Young's modulus",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The solid-phase Young's modulus is not stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Use E=1 in normalized units.",
        "Use E=200 GPa with consistent dimensional units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 2.1.1, Eqs. (1)-(4), and Sec. 4 numerical-example settings give no solid-phase Young's modulus."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid-material Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson's ratio is supplied for the isotropic solid used in the reconstruction.",
      "readings": [
        "Use Poisson's ratio 0.30.",
        "Use Poisson's ratio 1/3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 2.1.1 and Sec. 4 numerical-example settings do not specify Poisson's ratio."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The two-dimensional example is not explicitly identified as plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Use plane-stress elasticity.",
        "Use plane-strain elasticity."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 2.1.1 equilibrium formulation and Sec. 4.2 mesh descriptions do not state the planar constitutive assumption."
    }
  ]
}
